Hi Theo, re: ROUTEKIT-117 tie-breaking. The design review rule is 'fewer legs wins' when cost is tied. So ['S','B','T'] (2 legs) should beat ['S','M','A','T'] (3 legs). If test_regression_issue_506 expects the longer path, that test likely needs updating to match the agreed rule. 'Legs' = number of path segments (edges), so path length - 1.
